ModMetadata.Name: CursorToggle
ModMetadata.Author: JXSN
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]CursorToggle[/h1]
Toggle the mouse cursor on/off by tapping Alt (or your bound MouseControl key).
Choose between single-tap or double-tap mode via the BepInEx config / SLP MOD MENU: [i]BepInEx/config/com.jacksonthemaster.cursortoggle.cfg[/i]
[h3]Latest test: 2026-05-13[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
CursorToggle WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin.
CursorToggle - Tap Alt (or your bound MouseControl key) to toggle the cursor on/off. Single-tap or double-tap mode configurable via BepInEx config. Brought to you by JacksonTheMaster
